AUTHOR: Cai
TITLE: Semi-supervised Visual Tracking of Marine Animals Using Autonomous Underwater Vehicles
REGION: US Virgin Islands (St. John), Puerto Rico, Pacific (Mesobot), REMUS deployments
SPECIES: 17 marine animal types incl. 9 reef fish taxa (parrotfish, lionfish, angelfish, boxfish, snapper, barracuda, jack, blue tang, striped fish), sharks, stingray, plus octopus, squid, jellyfish, larvacean, dolphin, turtle
DATA: Own VMAT dataset (33 densely labelled sequences, ~74K frames; diver GoPro, REMUS, Mesobot) + AUV (CUREE) field demonstrations
V_EV: Table 3 / Fig. 6: 'AL Active Lighting: Scene is predominantly illuminated by AUV/diver; PL Passive Lighting' - success results per environmental attribute (qualitative strata)
D2: evaluation-only dataset; trackers used as provided (pretrained on generic data)
D_EV: Sec. 3.1: 'Our dataset... is used for evaluation only' (no train/test split; trackers 'run... as provided')
R_EV: Sec. 4.1: 'All these algorithms utilize pre-trained (using generic datasets) deep convolutional neural networks' - tested on underwater VMAT; in-domain scores not reported
C_EV: no statement found (only IoU/pixel thresholds for success/precision curves; no score threshold)
E_EV: Sec. 4.2: 'we consider the (1) success rate, (2) precision, and normalized precision metrics' - AUV trajectory only a qualitative proxy demo
ARCH: 13 semi-supervised single-object trackers (KeepTrack, SuperDiMP, TrDiMP, SiamRPN++, etc.)
METR: Success AUC, precision@20px, normalized precision, FPS
NOTE: Multi-taxon SOT benchmark; fish (incl. sharks/ray) are ~19 of 33 sequences but no fish-only quantitative results -> INCL judged Y with low confidence. No training on VMAT, so split unit not applicable -> D1 NR. R1=Y because off-the-shelf trackers trained on generic datasets are evaluated on underwater data, but in-domain numbers not given -> R3 N. V2: Mesobot sequences from twilight zone 100-3000 m; V3: active/passive lighting attribute. AUV 3D trajectory (Fig. 9) is a vehicle-trajectory proxy, not evaluated -> E1 coded 없음 (verifier may consider 행동). arXiv text version used.
